title: Day 27/28 - Deploy a 3 Tier Architecture In Azure Using Terraform | Real-time Project

description:
In this video, marking Day 27/28 of our real-time project, we tackle a core cloud concept: deploying a robust 3-tier architecture in Microsoft Azure. We'll be leveraging the power of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform to automate the entire process, from networking to application and database tiers.

Watch as I walk through the Terraform configurations needed to provision the necessary Azure resources, manage dependencies, and ensure a repeatable deployment. This isn't just theory; we're building a practical setup that mirrors real-world scenarios.

If you're learning Azure, Terraform, or Infrastructure as Code, this hands-on example is crucial for understanding how to structure complex deployments efficiently and reliably.

What you'll learn in this video:
*   How to define Azure resources for a 3-tier architecture using Terraform.
*   Structuring your Terraform code for complex deployments.
*   Deploying networking components (VNets, subnets, NSGs).
*   Setting up application and database tiers with IaC.
*   Executing Terraform commands (`init`, `plan`, `apply`) for deployment.

Don't miss the culmination of this project!

Subscribe for more cloud, DevOps, and IaC tutorials!
